targets.query:
from(bucket: "BMS")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "battery" and
    r.packName == "${Battery_pack_01}" and
    r._field =~ /^cell[0-9]+V$/
  )
  |> window(every: v.windowPeriod)
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "packName"])
  |> reduce(
    identity: {minV: 1000000.0, maxV: 0.0},
    fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
      minV: if r._value < accumulator.minV then r._value else accumulator.minV,
      maxV: if r._value > accumulator.maxV then r._value else accumulator.maxV
    })
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._stop,
      _value: r.maxV - r.minV,
      _field: "cell_imbalance",
      _measurement: "battery"
  }))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
